verdict.rationale: A keyless runtime probe shows learn.chatgpt.com/llms.txt returns a docs index with a dedicated '## Dots' section listing every dots page. Each page can be fetched as raw markdown by appending .md, which a separate probe confirmed returns text/markdown. The automated docs-md 404 came from appending .md twice, so it does not contradict this. Missing for 10: the llms.txt is a shared vendor index headed 'Codex' rather than dots-specific, and there is no independent community corroboration of agents using it.
